title: Sizing and portfolio-risk recipe

recipe_name.description: max100;unique within account policy scope. Private draft only

product_profile_id.description: verified compatible product schema. Defines units and multiplier

risk_basis.description: must be allowed by the selected product profile. No algorithm inferred from a name

risk_amount.description: required for loss_budget;positive;at or below released ceiling. Currency or percent basis supplied by verified account policy

risk_currency.description: required for money amount;must match approved basis. No implicit FX conversion

minimum_quantity.description: server instrument minimum;cannot raise quantity beyond risk. Smaller signals may be rejected

maximum_quantity.description: nonnegative compatible units;at or below account hard cap. Does not replace buying-power checks

account_limit_policy_id.description: released server policy;customer cannot weaken it. Preview all applicable account and owner limits

allocation_policy_id.description: compatible released overlap/reservation policy. Shared capital and pending orders remain counted

cost_stress_policy_id.description: verified product-specific cost and stress convention. A stop price is not guaranteed loss

description: Ready-input schema plus server business validation. Draft input uses identical property types but permits missing required fields; missingness must be displayed. Identity/password forms never saved as drafts.
